          About this item

          • 【EASY INSTALLATION & REMOVAL】 Designed with a twist-to-open inner PC shell. To install, simply place your AirTag inside, rotate the PC shell to the "ON" position to lock it, and insert the whole piece into the silicone holder. To remove, just push it out of the silicone case, rotate to the "OFF" position, and easily take your AirTag out—no tools required, making battery replacement a breeze.
          • 【IPX8 Professional Waterproof & Sweatproof】 Built to IPX8 waterproof standards and paired with the tight-seal inner shell, this case effectively blocks rain, sweat, daily splashes, and dust. Whether you are hiking outdoors, commuting in the rain, or using it on your pet's collar, you can rest assured that your AirTag stays completely dry and operates without signal interference.
          • 【Sturdy Metal Keychain & Multi-Scene Application】 Equipped with a high-quality stainless steel metal ring on top, it is strong, durable, and rust-proof. Easily attach it to keychains, backpack zippers, pet collars, baby strollers, luggage, and other personal valuables. Clip it on and go—making it effortless to track your important belongings anytime, anywhere.
          • 【Skin-Friendly Silicone & Long-Lasting Freshness】 The outer liquid silicone is made of eco-friendly materials, featuring a smooth, soft, and non-slip texture. It is stain-resistant, sweat-proof, scratch-resistant, and built to last. It won't turn yellow or deform after prolonged use, and it stays odor-free even in summer heat or daily friction, ensuring a comfortable and pleasant user experience.
          • 【Upgraded Twist-Lock & Dual-Layer Protection】 Custom-designed for Apple AirTag 1st and 2nd Gen, the precise cutouts fit perfectly without obstructing signal transmission. Different from ordinary silicone cases, this protective cover features a detachable hard PC inner shell combined with a soft silicone outer layer. The unique rotating lock (Twist-Lock) design on the inner shell firmly secures your AirTag, completely preventing it from slipping out or getting lost. The high-elastic silicone outer layer provides strong cushioning against accidental bumps and drops, offering ultimate peace of mind for your tracker. (Note: AirTag is NOT included.)

          • 【IPX8 Professional Waterproof & Sweatproof】 Built to IPX8 waterproof standards and paired with the tight-seal inner shell, this case effectively blocks rain, sweat, daily splashes, and dust. Whether you are hiking outdoors, commuting in the rain, or using it on your pet's collar, you can rest assured that your AirTag stays completely dry and operates without signal interference.
          • 【Sturdy Metal Keychain & Multi-Scene Application】 Equipped with a high-quality stainless steel metal ring on top, it is strong, durable, and rust-proof. Easily attach it to keychains, backpack zippers, pet collars, baby strollers, luggage, and other personal valuables. Clip it on and go—making it effortless to track your important belongings anytime, anywhere.
          • 【Skin-Friendly Silicone & Long-Lasting Freshness】 The outer liquid silicone is made of eco-friendly materials, featuring a smooth, soft, and non-slip texture. It is stain-resistant, sweat-proof, scratch-resistant, and built to last. It won't turn yellow or deform after prolonged use, and it stays odor-free even in summer heat or daily friction, ensuring a comfortable and pleasant user experience.
          • 【Upgraded Twist-Lock & Dual-Layer Protection】 Custom-designed for Apple AirTag 1st and 2nd Gen, the precise cutouts fit perfectly without obstructing signal transmission. Different from ordinary silicone cases, this protective cover features a detachable hard PC inner shell combined with a soft silicone outer layer. The unique rotating lock (Twist-Lock) design on the inner shell firmly secures your AirTag, completely preventing it from slipping out or getting lost. The high-elastic silicone outer layer provides strong cushioning against accidental bumps and drops, offering ultimate peace of mind for your tracker. (Note: AirTag is NOT included.)

          Product Description

          EASY INSTALLATION & REMOVAL: Designed with a twist-to-open inner PC shell. To install, simply place your AirTag inside, rotate the PC shell to the "ON" position to lock it, and insert the whole piece into the silicone holder. To remove, just push it out of the silicone case, rotate to the "OFF" position, and easily take your AirTag out—no tools required, making battery replacement a breeze.
